title: Chapter 15
content_zh: Yang Jian, with his third eye in his forehead that could see through all illusions, was the greatest warrior of the Chan sect. His transformations exceeded even Sun Wukong's — he could become anything, and his dog, the Celestial Hound, could track any spirit across the three realms.
content_en: Yang Jian, with his third eye in his forehead that could see through all illusions, was the greatest warrior of the Chan sect. His transformations exceeded even Sun Wukong's — he could become anything, and his dog, the Celestial Hound, could track any spirit across the three realms.
